AssignUserRolesRequest.description:
Wave B contract: replace the target's role set with catalogue roles. The
wave owning the route enforces UserPolicy::assignRoles (no self-assignment,
last active admin preserved) for the resolved target inside a
PrivilegeTransaction.

Grant ceiling: a non-admin actor may only assign roles whose permissions are
all held by the actor (directly or through the actor's roles). The role list
is evaluated as a whole — if any requested role exceeds the ceiling (or is
the admin role), nothing is assigned. Policy denials, including the ceiling,
respond 403 Forbidden with the unauthorized message; unknown role names are
rejected earlier by validation with 422.
AssignUserRolesRequest.title: AssignUserRolesRequest

SetUserStatusRequest.description:
Wave B contract: activate or deactivate an account. The wave owning the
route enforces UserPolicy::setStatus (self and last-admin protections)
for the resolved target inside a PrivilegeTransaction.
SetUserStatusRequest.title: SetUserStatusRequest

UpdateRolePermissionsRequest.description:
Wave B contract: replace a role's permission set with catalogue
permissions. The wave owning the route enforces RolePolicy::updatePermissions
(admin role immutable) for the resolved role inside a PrivilegeTransaction.
UpdateRolePermissionsRequest.title: UpdateRolePermissionsRequest
